name: For Honor: Arakure - Hero
summary:
The Arakure Hero offer includes:

- 1 New Hero: Arakure
- 1 Ornament
- 1 Elite Outfit
- 7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
- 3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

Live by your own rules and rely on your instincts. Take on multiple opponents and fight dirty to steal another victory. Wielding tonfas, Arakure packs a punch. Her brazen personality brings a unique perspective to the Samurai faction and with weapons never seen before, she is not afraid to do what it takes to win a fight. Explosive, scrappy, Arakure will hit you where it hurts.
